text.description_html:
KABA 5010 Simplex Keypad Exit Device Trim with Key Override

The new KABA Simplex 5010 Heavy Duty Keypad Exit Device Trim with Key Override features strong rugged contemporary design and an ADA compliant door lever. Simplex mechanical pushbutton locks are well known for durability. Provides exterior access by combination, while allowing free egress with exit device. Easy to install, program and maintain. Exit device may be dogged without affecting the 5010.

Limit access to high-traffic, security-sensitive areas in commercial, institutional, industrial, government and military buildings. Ideal for locations with frequent personal turnover such as data processing centers, employee entrances, motels, dormitories, volunteer fire departments, airports and hospitals.

Features of the KABA Simplex 5010 Keypad for Exit Device

  • Includes Key Override Lock Cylinder
  • Easy to maintain - no batteries to replace.
  • Durable extra heavy duty construction.
  • Removable or interchangeable I/C cores
  • Single access code—one easy to manage code for all users
  • Lock is easily programmed via keypad without removing lock from the door.
  • Highly weather resistant
  • Heavy Duty - ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 (highest grade)
  • ADA Compliant

Specifications of KABA Simplex 5010

  • Construction: Extra heavy duty, solid cast housings, solid cast ADA Compliant levers, and wear tested for extensive use in indoor and outdoor applications.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" to 2-1/4"
  • Minimum Stile: 5"
  • Installation: Easily installs on wood or metal doors.
  • Control: Includes DF59 keys and screwdriver for combination change.
  • Key Override: Standard with Schlage "C" Keyway key-in-lever cylinder. Optional small format Interchangeable Core I/C (Less Core) and large format removable cores.
  • Handing: Non-handed, field reversible.
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, mechanical 5 button plus Enter Button keypad, anodized aluminum.
  • Fire Rating: Three (3) hour UL/ULC fire rating for "A" labeled doors.
  • Environmental: Highly weather resistant; for exterior or interior use.
  • Warranty: Three (3) Years.
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • KABA Simplex 5000 Series Specifications (PDF)

**Exterior trim only. Exit device sold separately.**
